newsitem.title: ROMANIA: Bucharest bourse prices mixed, volumes lower.
newsitem.headline: Bucharest bourse prices mixed, volumes lower.

text.p: 1225 GMT - Shares on the Bucharest bourse were mixed on Wednesday, with eight listings edging up, 11 going down and four stocks flat amid thinner volumes.
* Investor interest still focused on high-caps Oltchim chemical plant and Azomures fertiliser maker, which were heavily traded.
* Selling pressure sent Oltchim 50 lei weaker to close at 1,350, while Azomures gained 20 lei to end at 1,870.
* Demand on newcomer drug maker Antibiotice ATBE.BX was strong, pushing its price up by 1,300 lei against the opening quote. It closed at 3,500 lei.
* Turnover fell by 812.1 million lei to 4.02 billion lei.
* Three second-tier stocks had no trade on Wednesday when six companies were suspended pending announcements on their shareholders' meetings.
